# Dipesh Kharel (Hsepid)

> Dipesh Kharel, also known online as Hsepid, is a Nepali founder, developer, writer, composer and photographer based in Kathmandu, Nepal. He is Founder & CEO of NEXUS and Aivoke.Ai and a Grade 12 Science student at Cosmic International Academy. This site is his personal portfolio: software projects, a blog, art, original music, photography, vlogs and an on-page AI assistant (DK AI).

Canonical site: https://www.dipeshkharel14.com.np/ (also: khareldipesh.com.np)
Contact: dipeshkharel144@gmail.com
Updated: 2026-10-25
Note: the site is a single page. Blog, Music and Photography open as overlays from the "My Collections" wheel and can be linked with #blog, #music and #photography.

## About
- [Home / portfolio](https://www.dipeshkharel14.com.np/): biography, projects, collections, contact
- [YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/@DipeshKharel14): Dipesh Kharel's channel
- [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/its_mr_hsepid): @its_mr_hsepid

## Flagship projects
- [NEXUS](https://nexus144.vercel.app): AI-powered education platform
- [Aivoke.Ai](https://aivokeai.vercel.app): AI assistant and automation platform
- [Personal AI](https://personal-ai14.vercel.app): personal AI chat assistant
- [Gita Prabhav](https://gita-prabhav14.vercel.app): devotional site themed around the Bhagavad Gita
- [Shreekunja Optical](https://shreekunja-optical.vercel.app): catalog and billing site for an optical shop
- [BANTBHA](https://bantbha.vercel.app): community utility web app

## Other projects
- [Ghost Detector](https://dipeshkharel14-hub.github.io/Ghost-detector-/): anomaly "ghost" detection demo
- [Lens Simulation](https://dipeshkharel14-hub.github.io/Lens-simulator-/): interactive optics and lens simulator
- [Project Gesture](https://dipeshkharel14-hub.github.io/Gesture/): gesture-based interaction demo
- [Hacking Screen](https://dipeshkharel14-hub.github.io/open_system/): simulated hacking-terminal interface
- [Pashu Bali](https://dipeshkharel14-hub.github.io/Pashu-bali/): awareness project on animal sacrifice
- [Character.ai](https://dipeshkharel14-hub.github.io/Character.ai/): custom AI character chat experience

## Writing and books
- [Caste System and Human Consciousness](https://www.dipeshkharel14.com.np/Cast%20discrimination%20conceptual%20book%20by%20dipesh.pdf): social commentary on caste-based discrimination in Nepal, legal remedies and the path to equality (PDF, 2026)
- Wave of Human Life: book in progress by Dipesh Kharel
- Blog: https://www.dipeshkharel14.com.np/#blog

## Photography
Photographs by Dipesh Kharel, taken across Nepal (Kavre, Dhading, Bhaktapur, Kathmandu and more). Gallery: https://www.dipeshkharel14.com.np/#photography
- Nepali women: nepali local vlogger with doko and selfie stick in village (Nepal, 2026-09-20)
- Sunset view: beautiful sunset view from mountain (Kavre,Nepal, 2026-09-20)
- Supernova: royal enfield at mountain during sunset (kavre,Nepal, 2026-09-24)
- 300+year old tree: Kharel cast god(kuladevta) is located in the root of this tree (timal,nepal, 2026-09-22)
- Naransthan temple: located in Kavre (Nepal, 2026-09-23)
- Bauddha and Swyambhu: mini version located in Naransthan temple (Kavre, 2026-09-23)
- Beautiful hills: view of hills and mountains during day time (kaklin,nepal, 2026-09-09)
- Making Nepali swing: photp clicked during making nepali swing (kuruwas,Nepal, 2026-09-24)
- Sun rays: raw image of sun and its rays (Dhading,Nepal, 2026-09-26)
- Buddhist flag: late day time (rosaiba,nepal, 2026-09-02)
- College night view: night iew of kathmandu and bhaktapur (ithuli, 2026-05-21)
- Cat: cat sleeping peacefully (Nepal, 2026-06-23)
- Waterfall: i captured this image while studying or visiting mystrical waterfall. whole journey is in my vlog section (Bagmati,Nepal, 2025-03-09)
- Night view: night view of BKT (bhaktapur, 2024-09-11)
